entities.summary: Wu Fang-hsien is a Taiwanese tennis player who specializes in doubles. She has a career-high WTA ranking in doubles of No. 27, achieved 8 September 2025. Wu has won three WTA Tour doubles titles. Wu Fang-Hsien was a athletes & competitors from Taipei (b. 1999-07-15, Taipei). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
